description: Contains an abstract class 'NotesServerSyncTask' responsible for synchronizing notes between local storage and a remote server. Implements methods for pushing local changes and pulling remote updates, handling network exceptions, and managing synchronization callbacks.

classes.name: NotesServerSyncTask
classes.description: An abstract class extending Thread that manages synchronization of notes between local storage and a remote server, including pushing local changes and pulling remote updates.

methods.name: addCallbacks
methods.description: Associates a list of synchronization callbacks with an account.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the synchronization process, calling pre- and post-execution hooks.

methods.name: pushLocalChanges
methods.description: Pushes local note changes to the server, handling creation, edits, and deletions.

methods.name: pullRemoteChanges
methods.description: Fetches remote note changes and updates local storage accordingly.

methods.name: onPreExecute
methods.description: Abstract method to run setup tasks before synchronization begins.

methods.name: onPostExecute
methods.description: Abstract method to run tasks after synchronization completes, receiving the sync result status.
